text: Thoma Bravo completed its acquisition of Medallia on October 29, 2021, in an all-cash transaction valued at $6.4 billion. On August 3, 2026 Medallia said it had transitioned ownership to an investor group led by funds managed by Blackstone, as well as Apollo and FS KKR Capital Corp.
short: Thoma Bravo owned Medallia from 2021 until August 2026.

source.name: Thoma Bravo press release: Thoma Bravo Completes Acquisition of Medallia
source.quote: Thoma Bravo, a leading software investment firm, today announced the completion of its acquisition of Medallia, a global leader in customer and employee experience, in an all-cash transaction valued at $6.4 billion.

additionalSources.name: Medallia press release: Medallia Closes Transaction to Fuel Company’s Next Chapter of AI-Driven Growth
additionalSources.quote: has officially transitioned ownership to an investor group led by funds managed by Blackstone, as well as Apollo, and FS KKR Capital Corp (FSK).
